entries.bookNote: Exodus 1:1–4:31 tells of Israel's oppression in Egypt, the birth and early life of Moses, his flight to Midian, and God's call from the burning bush. No independently established date is assigned.
Exodus 5:1–11:10 tells of Moses and Aaron before Pharaoh, the ten plagues, and Pharaoh's hardened refusal to let Israel go. No independently established date is assigned.
Exodus 12:1–15:21 tells of the Passover, the exodus from Egypt, the crossing of the sea, and the song of Moses and Miriam. No independently established date is assigned.

Exodus 15:22–18:27 tells of Israel's journey in the wilderness: the bitter water at Marah, manna and quail, water from the rock, the battle with Amalek, and Jethro's counsel. No independently established date is assigned.
Exodus 19:1–24:18 tells of Israel's arrival at Sinai, the covenant, the Ten Words, the Book of the Covenant, and the ratification of the covenant. No independently established date is assigned.
Exodus 25:1–34:35 tells of the instructions for the tabernacle, the golden calf, the breaking and renewal of the covenant, and the second tablets. No independently established date is assigned.
Exodus 35:1–40:38 tells of the building of the tabernacle, its furnishing, and the glory of the LORD filling it. No independently established date is assigned.

introduction: Exodus tells of Israel's deliverance from Egypt, the covenant at Sinai, and the dwelling of God among his people. Biblical History presents the passage alongside carefully qualified ancient cultural and literary context.
title: Exodus
